parse.title: Redemption Code
parse.text:
Redemption Code

Type

Game Systems
Redemption codes are released as part of events, milestones, or other promotions. They can be redeemed for in-game items.

Codes can be redeemed in two ways:

  • Website: Through the official Honkai Star Rail Redeem code page. (For Global servers)
  • In-Game: Through the Menu (Mobile Phone Icon) ➤ Profile Settings (... Icon) ➤ Redemption Code. (For all servers, excluding iOS‍[any others?] platforms)

Additionally, the following requirements must be met:

  • Complete the Trailblaze Mission A Moment of Peace to unlock the Mail feature

All Codes[]

All times listed below are according to UTC. Also note that "indefinite" does not mean "infinite," a code can become unredeemable if it hits its max usage limit or if HoYoverse decides to revoke it.
